preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or gain ownership through transferOwnership)
Contract must hold some BNB balance (native currency) from accumulated fees or liquidity

exploit_hint: The contract inherits from Ownable but doesn't override the selfdestruct functionality. As the owner, call selfdestruct with the attacker's address as beneficiary to drain all BNB from the contract. First ensure the contract has BNB balance from accumulated fees via swapAndLiquify mechanism. Use: selfdestruct(payable(attacker_address)).
